items.text: The prefix "**об**-" indicates a motion around a place and may mean:
points: Circling a place. The verb is followed by the preposition **вокруг** + Gen.: **Самолёт облетел вокруг аэродрома**. **Я хочу объехать вокруг озера**.
Making a detour. No preposition is used; the verb is followed by the Accusative case: **Мы объехали это место**. **Противник обошёл наш город**.

Making the rounds of … or going all over … No preposition is used; the verb is followed by the Accusative case: **Я обошёл все магазины**. — I made the rounds of all the stores. **Я обошёл весь город**. — I walked all over town.

head: prefix / primary meanings
examples / additional meanings
prepositional phrases
rows: **о-, об-, обо-** — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle. Я обхожу все магазины в центре. — I'm going around to all the stores in the mall.
**из-, изо-, ис-** — Movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion
Я изъездил весь мир. — I traveled over the whole world.

imperfective
Wiktionary's definition
rows: to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area)
to travel (all over); to go round, to make a detour, to take the bypass
to fly (round); (rumor, news etc) to spread (all over)

to run around .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with accusative or вокру́г (vokrúg, + genitive) ‘a location’]; to run [with ми́мо (mímo, + genitive) ‘past a location’] (to bypass while running)
to lead (someone around); to encircle, to surround
(transitive) to swim around; (intransitive) to swell up; to become bloated; to gutter (of a candle)
(imperfective only) to issue (from), to come (from), to originate (from), to emanate (from); (imperfective only) to proceed (from), to base oneself (on))
to go, to travel all over; to ruin (e.g. a road) by riding on for too long

exercises.why: **исходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).

**обежали** — past tense (plural) of обежать: perfective (imperfective partner: обегать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).

**исходило** — past tense (neuter) of исходить: imperfective.  Prefix **из-, изо-, ис-**: movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion (without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: From the sphere emanated some kind of strange glow.

exercises.q: Осень, и с деревьев ___ (облетать / облететь) листья.
exercises.why: **облетают** — present tense (3rd person plural) of облетать: imperfective (perfective partner: облететь).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: It's autumn and the leaves are falling from the trees.

exercises.q: Том ___ (обвести / обводить) в кружок три имени в списке.
exercises.why: **обвёл** — past tense (masculine) of обвести: perfective (imperfective partner: обводить).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom circled three names on the list.

exercises.q: Тома ___ (обвести / обводить) вокруг пальца нигерийские аферисты.
exercises.why: **обвели** — past tense (plural) of обвести: perfective (imperfective partner: обводить).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom was scammed by Nigerian scammers.

exercises.q: Интервью было снято на видео и затем ___ (облететь / облетать) весь Интернет.
exercises.why: **облетело** — past tense (neuter) of облететь: perfective (imperfective partner: облетать).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
exercises.prompt: The interview was recorded on video and shared all over the Internet.

exercises.q: Ты по чину ___ (обносить / обнести — to enclose)!
exercises.why: **обноси** — imperative (ты, singular) of обносить: imperfective (perfective partner: обнести).  Prefix **о-, об-, обо-**: movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place (вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc).
